project_identity.tagline: Professional AI Web Application for Crypto, Memecoins & NFT Trading
project_identity.design_archetype: ARCHETYPE 7 & 2 FUSION - Electric Obsidian High-Performance Tactical Web3
project_identity.theme_mode: Dark Theme Default (Obsidian #090B10, Fiery Phoenix Accents #FF5500 / #FF2E00, Cyber Gold #FFB800, Emerald Gains #00E676, Crimson Risk #FF1744)
project_identity.target_audience: Crypto traders, NFT collectors, DeFi yield hunters, memecoin scalpers, and AI quantitative trading enthusiasts
project_identity.emotional_tone: High-octane precision, quantitative authority, fiery kinetic energy, tactical clarity, web3 futuristic elegance

visual_enhancers.hero_and_surfaces: Deep obsidian glassmorphism with delicate ember glow borders (`border-amber-500/20 hover:border-orange-500/40`), subtle background noise grain texture, neon cyber accents, dynamic glowing tracing beams on active trade cards.
visual_enhancers.brand_logo: Firebird / Phoenix icon must be prominently preserved in top-left navigation with animated ember glow and fiery gradient text ('FIREBIRD AI').
visual_enhancers.rtl_support: Full Right-To-Left layout support for Persian (FA) language option alongside 10 global languages (EN, ES, DE, FR, ZH, JA, RU, PT, TR, FA). Dynamic direction switching (`dir='rtl'` and `font-fa` for Persian typography).

typography.font_family_heading: Outfit, Clash Display, Space Grotesk, system-ui
typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, monospace for tickers, prices, wallet addresses, and gas fees
typography.font_family_persian: Vazirmatn, Noto Sans Arabic, sans-serif for Persian RTL mode

layout_and_grid.architecture: Fixed Header + Left Central Navigation Sidebar + Scrollable Main Content Workspace + Right Market Feed / AI Assistant Panel (Collapsible)
layout_and_grid.navigation_sidebar: Fixed left sidebar (right side in RTL mode) containing core navigation: Dashboard, Live Charts, Signals, Auto-Trade, Manual Trade, Memecoin Trap Scanner, 5x5 Backtest, Positions & Reports, NFT Collection (Firebird 555), Strategy Lab, Exchange Hub, Beginner Guide TOC.
layout_and_grid.bento_grid_mode: MODE B: High Density Tactical Dashboard Grid (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6`). Child widgets must use `h-full` to align perfectly without jagged edges.
layout_and_grid.padding_system: Generous spacing philosophy: Cards have `p-5` to `p-6` internal padding to prevent content collision with 1px borders.

demo_sandbox_mode.behavior: Real trading off by default. Auto buy/sell and manual orders operate seamlessly in $100 Demo Sandbox mode with live price simulation.

ai_assistant_model.name: GPT-5.6 AI Core
ai_assistant_model.capabilities: Coin safety scoring (0-100), automated signal generation, risk lock monitoring, trap/fake token detection, and backtesting strategy recommendations.

memecoin_scanner.anti_scam_filter: Strict trap detection analyzing liquidity locks, mint authority, honeypot code, rugpull risk score, and holder concentration. Only highlights memecoins with score >= 75/100.

nft_collection.name: Firebird 555 Album
nft_collection.features: Interactive 3D/hover gallery, metadata inspector, rarity rank filter, simulated floor price & bidding.

exchange_hub.features: API Key management toggle, connection status indicators, sandbox vs live mode switch.

instructions_to_main_agent: Rebuild Firebird AI Trade in React (JS/JSX) with Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, Recharts/Chart.js, Sonner toast, and Framer Motion.
Preserve Firebird logo motif with fiery gradient and ember glow effects.
Ensure $100 Demo Mode is enabled by default with real-time portfolio simulation.
Implement Persian language (FA) support with full RTL direction shift (`dir='rtl'`).
Integrate memecoin scanner with safety scoring (detecting scam/trap tokens).
Integrate NFT 555 collection gallery highlighting the 6 special rare items.
Ensure all interactive elements carry proper `data-testid` attributes.
